title: Tesla Autopilot Failing (No Warnings) Where There Was A Fatal Car Accident W Model X
summary: A Tesla Model S/X owner films his drive on US-101 in the lane where a fatal Model X Autopilot crash occurred, showing the car steering toward the lane divider without any warning.
why: It is cited as evidence that other drivers could reproduce the Autopilot behavior in the fatal crash, mostly in critical discussions of Autopilot safety.

quote.text: This guy tested it at the EXACT same location with tesla autopilot.
